title: Limit cone for a K-injective tower
statement: Let A be an abelian category with countable products. For every cochain complex I of inverse systems indexed by the opposite of the natural numbers, its associated functor from that indexing category to cochain complexes over A has a limit cone.

proof.text: Countable products in A induce countable products of complexes. The tower has countably many objects and arrows. Products indexed by these two sets and equalizers construct the limit, using Mathlib hasLimit_of_equalizer_and_product.

proof_origin.note: Proved from Mathlib countable products and equalizers; no derived category, exactness, enough injectives, or K-injectivity hypotheses are needed.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedCategory_towerLimit_cone
    (A : Type u) [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [HasCountableProducts A] :
    ∀ (I : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ℤ),
      ∃ c : Cone I.asFunctor, Nonempty (IsLimit c)
